scenes.setting: The solarium exit interview, played with a Faceless-aged face and a written report already in his pocket: Talim died of a heart attack, the detective is too weak, and he is going south. The prince releases him, and the manor shrinks behind the carriage — the stage left at last
scenes.text_anchor: He knew that he had left the center of the stage.

scenes.setting: The carriage door opens and shuts on the sapphire ring: it is Trissy, wanted Witch of the Demoness Sect, begging to be reported to any official organization — someone rewrites her life through coincidences, she cursed Talim without knowing it, and they have renamed her. 'Trissy Cheek.'
